parole.testo: From Akkadian 𒀲𒆪𒁷 (^(ANŠE)ku-din /⁠kūdunu, kūdanu, kūdannu, kūdinu⁠/), also Eblaite ...𒁕𒈝 (ku₁₇-da-núm /⁠kūdanum⁠/), equated to Sumerian 𒀲𒄊𒉣 (anše-ĝir₂-nun /⁠anšeĝirnun⁠/, “a type of equid”), potentially related also to Elamite 𒆪𒌅 (ku-tu /⁠kutu⁠/, “cattle”). Found in Ugaritic 𐎋𐎄𐎐𐎚 (kdnt, “she-mule”)
